scientific_integrity: The 2024 vertex-attainment theorem, Radon polygon characterization and already-known hexagon/decagon constants are explicitly credited; only the infinite-family two-branch evaluation and asymptotic split are offered as the new claim.
scientific_limitations: Classical James constant of regular real \((4m+2)\)-gonal planes only; no classification of every maximizing pair. The full 2020 Mizuguchi article was inaccessible; prior-coverage risk remains. Same mathematical model proof inspection and finite checker are not independent certification.
title: James constants and the modulo-eight facet law for regular Radon polygonal planes
